title: helpful constraints
name: Helpful constraints — NN/g
rule: Where acceptable values are known, constrain input so invalid data cannot be entered instead of failing later.

citation.source: NN/g — 4 Principles to Reduce Cognitive Load in Forms

pass_when: Known-valid set is constrained (picker, allowed charset, max length, stepper) so invalid values cannot be entered.
fail_when: Known-valid set is free text rejected only after entry.
overview: Constrain known-valid input so invalid values cannot be entered at all.
apply_when: Acceptable values are a known set, charset, length, or range.
not_when: Open free text where valid values are not known in advance.
agent_hint: Use pickers, charset, max length, or steppers so invalid data cannot enter.
description: Where acceptable values are known, constrain input — picker, allowed charset, max length, stepper — so invalid data cannot be entered instead of failing later. Pass when the known-valid set is constrained at entry; fail when that set is free text rejected only after entry. Prevention beats post-hoc error for closed domains where the valid set is already known.
